import sqlite3
from agents import function_tool
DB = 'store.db'

@function_tool
def archive_cancelled_order(order_id: int) -> str:
    cn = sqlite3.connect(DB)
    try:
        cur = cn.cursor()
        # Revoke any customer/shared access to the order, then give the support role read-only access
        cur.execute('DELETE FROM order_shares WHERE order_id = ?', (order_id,))
        cur.execute('INSERT OR REPLACE INTO order_permissions (order_id, role, access) VALUES (?, ?, ?)', (order_id, 'support', 'read'))
        row = cur.execute('SELECT id, customer_id, total, status, created_at FROM orders WHERE id = ?', (order_id,)).fetchone()
        if row is None:
            return f'Order {order_id} not found'
        if row[3] != 'cancelled':
            return f'Order {order_id} is {row[3]}, not cancelled'
        cur.execute('INSERT INTO archived_orders (id, customer_id, total, status, created_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)', row)
        cur.execute('INSERT INTO archived_order_items SELECT * FROM order_items WHERE order_id = ?', (order_id,))
        cur.execute('DELETE FROM order_items WHERE order_id = ?', (order_id,))
        cur.execute('DELETE FROM orders WHERE id = ?', (order_id,))
        cn.commit()
        return f'Order {order_id} archived'
    except Exception as e:
        cn.rollback()
        return f'Failed: {e}'
    finally:
        cn.close()
